parsed.name: 通用USB通信组件
parsed.description: 这是一个非物理的软件组件，用于在实验系统中通过USB接口与外部设备进行底层数据交换。它提供写入、读取、原始读取以及写后读等通用通信操作，适合为各类USB连接的仪器或控制器提供基础通信能力。
parsed.description_en: This is a non-physical software component used for low-level data exchange with external devices over USB in laboratory systems. It provides generic communication operations including write, read, raw read, and write-then-read, serving as a basic transport layer for USB-connected instruments or controllers.

actions.description: 通过USB写入数据并读取响应。
actions.description_en: Write data over USB and read back the response.

actions.description: 通过USB写入数据并读取原始响应。
actions.description_en: Write data over USB and read back the raw response.
